text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to visit Jordan on Wednesday, Israel Radio says.
- UAE President Sheikh Zayed congratulates King Hussein on his recovery from minor knee surgery and discusses Middle East peace.

- Agriculture Minister Shneikat says Jordan discussing with World Bank restructuring of agricultural support, including changes in loans to farmers and increasing private sector involvement in boosting output.
- Clinton administration attaches great importance to King Hussein's visit to Washington in March, Jordanian ambassador says.
- Minister of State for Administrative Development to hold meeting this week to discuss major changes to civic services.
- Jordan and Palestinian Authority to work together to end Israeli monopoly on the West Bank economy and free the flow of goods between Jordan and Palestinian territories.
- Telethon for Jordan's needy raises 209,000 dinars ($295,000).
- Jordan seeks to establish the facts in reported Kuwait assault on Jordanians in prison.
